findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_references, get_journal_ai_policy, review_manuscript, review_manuscript_text, get_manuscript_review, list_manuscript_reviews · Private data: get_journal_ai_policy, review_manuscript, review_manuscript_text · Public sink: check_references, review_manuscript_text · Destructive: check_references.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_references, get_journal_ai_policy, review_manuscript, review_manuscript_text, get_manuscript_review, list_manuscript_reviews · Private data: get_journal_ai_policy, review_manuscript, review_manuscript_text · Public sink: check_references, review_manuscript_text · Destructive: check_references

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
